title: Lovely Light French Rhubarb Choux Pastry
description: A funky and juicy French dessert featuring rhubarb, perfect for kids and adults alike, with a roast halal-friendly twist in a choux pastry form
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium saucepan, combine the rhubarb, water, and sugar, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to medium low and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the rhubarb is tender.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, melted butter, eggs, salt, and vanilla extract to make the choux pastry dough.
Transfer the dough to a piping bag fitted with a large round tip.
Pipe the dough into small rounds onto a parchment lined baking sheet.
Spoon the cooked rhubarb mixture onto one half of each round, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the rhubarb to form a triangle or a square shape, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the tops of the pastry with a little bit of egg wash and bake for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
